audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose framed the lane as a shield-poke war and never named a single Azir ability, matching the packet defect.
audit.why: Azir's Q Conquering Sands is 14s at rank 1 and 6s maxed, so his poke is scarce early; his only escape is Shifting Sands (E) at 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s. Malzahar's E is 650 range against soldier attacks that outrange it.
audit.corrected: Early lane is Malzahar's on shove and silence; from Azir's first item onward soldier range and Emperor's Divide push the difficulty toward him.

audit.why: Spike order held up against the kit: E waveclear 3-5, R at 6 versus an Azir whose only escape is on a 22s rank-1 cooldown, then Azir's first item and Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s) flipping it.
audit.corrected: Left the four spikes; sharpened the level chart rows that disagreed with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Shifting Sands carries a shield that eats your burst window — the flagged missing interaction.
audit.why: Azir's E both dashes and shields; committing Q-E-R into an intact E means the shield absorbs the opening damage and the dash removes him from your 650 E range.
audit.corrected: tldr and the trade rules now bait Shifting Sands out first; cooldowns field carries its real 22s-to-16s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit and named a nonexistent 'Iron Boundary'; dosFull[2].d called Shifting Sands a fifteen-second cooldown.
audit.why: Shifting Sands is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s — never fifteen. 'Iron Boundary' is not an ability in either kit.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank cooldowns for Q, E and R written into breakdown.cooldowns; the fabricated name removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their own titles, grounded in Malefic Visions bouncing and Conquering Sands' 740 range.

edits.before: His poke pops your shield, your shove pops his tempo — the lane is a war between his range and your metronome.
edits.after: Shifting Sands shields him through your burst — bait it out, then Q-silence and R have nothing to answer them.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Azir wins by farming to two items, where soldier range and Emperor's Divide keep you outside your 650 E range.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your spell shield (Iron Boundary) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands (E) is 22s at rank 1 and 16s maxed — his only escape, so step up the moment it is spent. - Conquering Sands (Q) is 14s at rank 1, so his poke is scarce early. - Emperor's Divide (R) is 120/105/90s and cancels your channel.

edits.before: Carry by subtraction — every fight starts 4v5 when your R lands; your job is the wave control that makes the fight happen on your timer.
edits.after: Carry by deleting Azir himself — he has one escape on a 16-second cooldown, and a suppression on him ends the fight before soldiers exist.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Malefic Visions bounces on kill and Voidlings finish the casters, so the wave crashes without you standing in Conquering Sands' 740-range slow line.

edits.before: Azir burns Shifting Sands on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Azir burns Shifting Sands on nothing — that is a 22-second window at rank 1.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Walking in without your passive damage reduction up means Conquering Sands and a soldier auto chunk you before you reach 650 E range.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns every crashed wave into a map play. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: visions melt waves AND health bars. Suppress-into-burn kills through most defensive answers.
edits.after: His first item lands and soldiers outrange you: Conquering Sands pokes through the wave while you cannot reach him.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide (90s at rank 3) knocks you off any commit; you only get R on a carry someone else has locked first.

notes: phases[N].side rows 0-3 and 5-6 were a blanket 'Skill' that contradicted both win[N] and packet.levelChart; moved side to match content, so no win[N] edits were needed (they would have been no-ops). Row 4 already agreed. 'Iron Boundary' in breakdown.cooldowns was a fabricated ability name and is gone. Malzahar's passive is unnamed in the kit file, so I referred to it as 'your passive damage reduction' rather than guessing a name.
